connections.meaning: Position roles explain the conditional predictor inputs, without an added scientific dataflow.
Conceptual attention rule inside the shared predictor, not an actual enlarged snapshot or a matrix-valued model input.
Fixed context c conditions each displayed shared noise predictor.
Only the final continuous latent feeds VAE decoding.

checks: Query rows and key columns preserve the same input order; permission is Boolean, not softmax.
The sampler combines state and predicted noise; epsilon is not itself the next state.
All shown intervals reuse theta and fixed context, with unspecified solver details.
No actual token counts, numerical latents or generated image is claimed.
uncertainties: Independently arranged program-built development example, not a model-planning quality result. Free native composition; the complete edited layout is not an atomic parametric recipe.
